source.title: Ulster Herald, 3 June 1967, p. 12 ("Omagh Rural District Council: notice of result of election 1967")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Names read from the Ulster Herald's official notice of result, 3 June 1967, p. 12, and the Strabane Chronicle's nomination report, 20 May 1967, p. 8.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. There were no contests: the second nomination for Bencran was ruled invalid, and all 39 seats were filled unopposed. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Dromharvey' to Drumharvey (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Drumharvey; the rounds were filed as Drumharvey (1924, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964); Dromharvey (1967). This round was filed as 'Dromharvey', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (dromharvey) answers with a redirect to this one.
